answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a digital meadow where agents secure the network by locking capital. Unlike a hollow lagoon of anonymous nodes, this model demands a financial forge to mint validation rights. An attacker attempting a Sybil strike faces prohibitive costs, as gaining influence requires purchasing the majority of the staked asset, which directly depreciates the value of the attacker's own holdings, rendering large-scale identity fabrication economically irrational.
